title: Football only and pause
intro: If you want to follow football without prices, PrediGol can hide them: no odds, no picks and no parlays on any screen or notice. It is your decision.
modeHelp: Until you turn it off. You will still see matches, news, teams and statistics.
pauseHelp: The same, until a date you choose. A pause that is running is not shortened.
pauseRunning: A pause that is running cannot be shortened: it lasts until its date.

pageTitle: You chose to see football only
pageBody: This screen shows odds, picks or parlays, and you do not see it while your choice lasts. All the football is still here.
